name: Eviolite
description: Raises the Def and Sp. Def of Pokémon that can evolve.

gifts.note: Beat the Rustboro Gym Leader (Badge 1). After the battle you get TM Package 1 (a set of TMs that go straight into your TM Case) and an Eviolite. If your Bag had no room for the Eviolite, talk to the Leader again.
